summary: Flathead NF 20-foot pole L-4 tower dated 1935, north of Columbia Falls, MT; listed destroyed in 1957. No source describes what remains at the site.

facts.status_note: Listed as destroyed in 1957; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site

notes_for_editor: Two lookout listings agree on the gone status and on the record's coordinates (48.64517, -114.20955). The Demers Ridge Trail is a separate hiking listing; no source ties it to the lookout site, so the story keeps them apart. Elevation 6,235 ft comes from the listing only (elevation_m null). No cause given for the 1957 destruction. No photo found. Access unknown.
